chunks: From him, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: “Whoever gives the adhan in a city from among the cities of the Muslims for one year, Paradise becomes obligatory for him.”

key_terms.أَذَّنَ: gave the adhan; proclaimed the call to salat (prayer)
key_terms.أَمْصَارِ: major towns or cities of the Muslims
key_terms.الْجَنَّةُ: Paradise; the promised abode of reward
key_terms.مِصْرٍ: a city or settled urban center

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for giving the adhan for one year in a Muslim city?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys the great merit of giving the adhan consistently in a Muslim city for a full year. It emphasizes the spiritual reward of serving the community through the public call to salat (prayer), promising al-jannah for such devotion.
